summary: Computer Science undergraduate at National University of Singapore specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Database Systems. bullets.text: Engineered an AI / NLP trade validation pipeline reconciling unstructured trade inputs with structured datasets, achieving 97% accuracy and cutting manual workload by 80% across Middle Office workflows.
Shipped solution as a FastAPI microservice with asynchronous batch processing, cutting validation turnaround time by 70% within enterprise trading infrastructure.

Designed a semantic clause library using normalization and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) validation, lowering recurring mismatches by 35% while strengthening contract consistency across commodity trades.

Developed internal ETL pipelines transforming raw fixed-income and derivative trade data into structured analyst-ready datasets, decreasing interpretation errors by 40% and accelerating reconciliation workflows.
Implemented automated QA data generation pipelines using Python and MySQL and introduced test-driven development with 300+ unit tests, raising coverage to 95%.
Led end-to-end Viber API integration across seven international partners, enabling reliable production messaging at scale through structured testing and edge-case validation.
Optimized AWS deployment workflows through monitoring and automation scripts, cutting deployment time by 20% and lowering compute costs by 15%.
